## Où j'en suis
After merging PR #418 (draggable/resizable grid), we implemented keyboard navigation (move, resize, drop/cancel) and a visible focus ring per Priya’s review. The initial attempt using `@dnd-kit` caused event collision and duplicate layout updates, so a custom `useGridKeyboard()` hook was written instead. The branch is tested and committed. The `dashboards_v2` flag is currently live only for the Zest workspace on staging to prep for the Nov 24 demo. The VisX migration (#401) was fully rolled back due to bundle overhead and rewrite workload, keeping Recharts. Production activation is scheduled for the morning of the 24th. (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-3, src-pr418)

- [en-cours] Final validation of the new keyboard hook and focus ring styling against existing mouse-drag interactions in PR #423 (source: ses-db-4, d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Obtain review on PR #423, merge it, and schedule the production flag flip for the morning of November 24 (source: ses-db-4, d4-06)
- [essai-raté] Using `@dnd-kit`’s `KeyboardSensor` alongside `react-grid-layout` failed because both libraries intercepted the same pointer and key events, triggering duplicate moves and double layout changes (source: ses-db-4, d4-02)
- [décision] Abort the VisX migration and retain Recharts to prevent bundle bloat and avoid rewriting nine remaining chart components (source: ses-db-3, d3-03)
- [décision] Maintain legacy v1 dashboards behind the feature flag until January; enable `dashboards_v2` exclusively for Zest on staging prior to the demonstration (source: ses-db-2, b2-04; ses-db-4, d4-06)
